newsitem.title: UK: European cotton slow, spinners selective.
newsitem.headline: European cotton slow, spinners selective.

text.p: European cotton markets tended slow after a May Day holiday in several centres on Thursday, and spinners were anyhow disposed to cover raw cotton needs selectively.

Few mill buyers seem convinced that the supply position warrants a significant price rise before the movement of the northern hemisphere 1997/98 crops in the autumn. Modest inquiry seen on Friday was mostly of a price testing nature.
The UK is closed for a holiday on Monday. The next report in this series appears on May 6.
